papers.title: MobileA3gent: Training Mobile GUI Agents Using Decentralized Self-Sourced Data from Diverse Users
papers.authors: Wenhao Wang, Mengying Yuan, Zijie Yu, Guangyi Liu, Rui Ye, Tian Jin, Siheng Chen, Yanfeng Wang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Multi-Agent Governance & Intelligence Crew (MAGIC)
papers.intro: 本文提出MobileA3gent，一个通过自动标注用户日常操作轨迹（Auto-Annotation）并结合自适应联邦聚合（FedVLM-A）的协作学习框架，以极低成本训练出性能媲美中心化人工标注方法的移动GUI代理，同时保护用户隐私。

papers.title: GUI-Bee: Align GUI Action Grounding to Novel Environments via Autonomous Exploration
papers.authors: Yue Fan, Handong Zhao, Ruiyi Zhang, Yu Shen, Xin Eric Wang, Gang Wu
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz; Adobe Research
papers.intro: 本文提出GUI-Bee，一个基于MLLM的自主探索代理，通过强化学习驱动的高效探索收集环境专属数据，持续微调GUI动作定位模型，以使其适应新环境，并引入NovelScreenSpot基准验证效果。

papers.title: WebWalker: Benchmarking LLMs in Web Traversal
papers.authors: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 本文提出WebWalkerQA（一个评估LLM系统遍历网页获取深层信息的双语基准）和WebWalker（一个由探索者与批评者双智能体组成的框架），通过多步点击交互从给定根网站中提取信息并回答问题。

papers.title: InfiGUIAgent: A Multimodal Generalist GUI Agent with Native Reasoning and Reflection
papers.authors: Yuhang Liu, Pengxiang Li, Zishu Wei, Congkai Xie, Xueyu Hu, Xinchen Xu, Shengyu Zhang, Xiaotian Han, Hongxia Yang, Fei Wu
papers.affiliations: 1Zhejiang University, 2Dalian University of Technology, 3Reallm Labs, 4ByteDance Inc, 5The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于两阶段监督微调的MLLM GUI Agent——InfiGUIAgent，通过在第一阶段增强基础理解与定位能力，在第二阶段引入层次推理和期望-反思推理的合成数据，赋予Agent原生推理能力，在多个GUI基准上取得竞争性能。

papers.title: Watch Video, Catch Keyword: Context-aware Keyword Attention for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection
papers.authors: Sung Jin Um, Dongjin Kim, Sangmin Lee, Jung Uk Kim
papers.affiliations: Kyung Hee University（庆熙大学）；Sungkyunkwan University（成均馆大学）
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种视频上下文感知的关键词注意力模块，通过视频上下文聚类和关键词权重检测动态调整文本查询中每个词的重要性，并配合关键词感知对比学习，在时刻检索和精彩片段检测任务上显著超越现有方法。

papers.title: A3: Android Agent Arena for Mobile GUI Agents with Essential-State Procedural Evaluation
papers.authors: Yuxiang Chai, Shunye Tang, Han Xiao, Weifeng Lin, Hanhao Li, Jiayu Zhang, Liang Liu, Pengxiang Zhao, Guangyi Liu, Guozhi Wang, Shuai Ren, Rongduo Han, Haining Zhang, Siyuan Huang, Hongsheng Li
papers.affiliations: Yuxiang Chai - MMLab @ CUHK, vivo AI Lab; Shunye Tang - Nankai University, vivo AI Lab; Han Xiao - MMLab @ CUHK, vivo AI Lab; Weifeng Lin - MMLab @ CUHK, vivo AI Lab; Hanhao Li - EE @ CUHK; Jiayu Zhang - EE @ CUHK; Liang Liu - vivo AI Lab; Pengxiang Zhao - vivo AI Lab; Guangyi Liu - vivo AI Lab; Guozhi Wang - vivo AI Lab; Shuai Ren - vivo AI Lab; Rongduo Han - Nankai University; Haining Zhang - Nankai University; Siyuan Huang - SJTU; Hongsheng Li - MMLab @ CUHK
papers.intro: 本文提出了Android Agent Arena (A3)，一个包含20个流行在线应用、100个真实任务的移动GUI agent基准，并引入了一种基于“essential-state”的程序化评估方法，利用MLLM作为奖励模型逐步验证任务完成和中间进展，克服了传统函数式评估在动态在线环境中的不足。

papers.title: Improving Text-based Person Search via Part-level Cross-modal Correspondence
papers.authors: Jicheol Park, Boseung Jeong, Dongwon Kim, Suha Kwak
papers.affiliations: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH), South Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于共享解码器和通用性边际排序损失的编码器-解码器模型，通过无监督跨模态语义对齐的粗到细嵌入和显式建模身体部位共性，全面提升文本描述行人搜索性能。

papers.title: Enhancing Visual Representation for Text-based Person Searching
papers.authors: Wei Shen, Ming Fang, Yuxia Wang, Jiafeng Xiao, Diping Li, Huangqun Chen, Ling Xu, Weifeng Zhang
papers.tags: CLIP, multimodal learning, image retrieval, video search
papers.affiliations: Metrological Verification and Testing Institute of Jiaxing, China; School of Artificial Intelligence, Zhejiang Sci-Tech University; College of Computer Science and Technology, Zhejiang University; College of Information Science and Engineering, Jiaxing University
papers.intro: 本文提出VFE-TPS模型，利用预训练CLIP作为多模态骨干，通过文本引导掩码图像建模和身份监督全局视觉特征校准两个辅助任务增强视觉特征，在仅需全局特征对齐的推理范式下显著提升文本描述行人搜索的Rank-1精度。

papers.title: OS-Genesis: Automating GUI Agent Trajectory Construction via Reverse Task Synthesis
papers.authors: Qiushi Sun, Kanzhi Cheng, Zichen Ding, Chuanyang Jin, Yian Wang, Fangzhi Xu, Zhenyu Wu, Chengyou Jia, Liheng Chen, Zhoumianze Liu, Ben Kao, Guohao Li, Junxian He, Yu Qiao, Zhiyong Wu
papers.affiliations: 未明确（正文第一页提供作者机构对应符号：♢Shanghai AI Laboratory, ♡The University of Hong Kong, ♣Johns Hopkins University, ♠Shanghai Jiao Tong University, ⋆University of Oxford,  Hong Kong University of Science and Technology）
papers.intro: 提出OS-Genesis，通过交互驱动探索和反向任务合成自动生成高质量、多样化的GUI代理轨迹，无需人类监督或预定义任务，并引入轨迹奖励模型确保数据质量，显著提升代理在动态基准上的性能。

papers.title: GUI Testing Arena: A Unified Benchmark for Advancing Autonomous GUI Testing Agent
papers.authors: Kangjia Zhao, Jiahui Song, Leigang Sha, Haozhan Shen, Zhi Chen, Tiancheng Zhao, Xiubo Liang, Jianwei Yin
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University (College of Computer Science and Technology); Tiancheng Zhao also affiliated with Om AI Research & Binjiang Institute of Zhejiang University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个形式化、标准化的自动化GUI测试基准GTArena，将测试过程划分为测试意图生成、测试任务执行和GUI缺陷检测三个子任务，并构建了包含真实应用、人工注入缺陷和合成数据的多源数据集，对多种多模态大模型进行全面评估，发现即便是最先进的模型在所有子任务中也难以表现良好，揭示了当前自动化GUI…

papers.title: PC Agent: While You Sleep, AI Works -- A Cognitive Journey into Digital World
papers.authors: Yanheng He, Jiahe Jin, Shijie Xia, Jiadi Su, Runze Fan, Haoyang Zou, Xiangkun Hu, Pengfei Liu
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, SII, Generative AI Research Lab (GAIR)
papers.intro: 通过高效捕获和转移人类使用计算机时的认知过程（而非仅行为数据），提出PC Agent框架，仅用133条认知轨迹训练即可实现处理多达50步跨应用复杂工作（如创建PPT），证明了高数据效率的数字代理训练范式。

papers.title: Aria-UI: Visual Grounding for GUI Instructions
papers.authors: Yuhao Yang, Yue Wang, Dongxu Li, Ziyang Luo, Bei Chen, Chao Huang, Junnan Li
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong (Yuhao Yang, Chao Huang), Salesforce AI Research (Ziyang Luo, Junnan Li), Alibaba Group (Yue Wang), Australian National University (Dongxu Li), Independent Researcher (Bei Chen)
papers.intro: Aria-UI 是一个纯视觉的大规模多模态模型，通过大规模多样化的指令数据合成和上下文感知的动作历史处理，在 GUI grounding 任务上达到了新的最先进水平，无需依赖 HTML 或 AXTree 等辅助输入。

papers.title: GUI Agents: A Survey
papers.authors: Dang Nguyen, Jian Chen, Yu Wang, Gang Wu, Namyong Park, Zhengmian Hu, Hanjia Lyu, Junda Wu, Ryan Aponte, Yu Xia, Xintong Li, Jing Shi, Hongjie Chen, Viet Dac Lai, Zhouhang Xie, Sungchul Kim, Ruiyi Zhang, Tong Yu, Mehrab Tanjim, Nesreen K. Ahmed, Puneet Mathur, Seunghyun Yoon, Lina Yao, Branislav Kveton, Jihyung Kil, Thien Huu Nguyen, Trung Bui, Tianyi Zhou, Ryan A. Rossi, Franck Dernoncourt
papers.affiliations: University of Maryland, State University of New York at Buffalo, University of Oregon, Adobe Research, University of Rochester, University of California, San Diego, Carnegie Mellon University, Dolby Labs, Cisco Research, University of New South Wales
papers.intro: 本文对GUI智能体进行了全面综述，提出了统一的框架将智能体的能力划分为感知、推理、规划和行动四个模块，系统总结了现有基准、评估指标、架构设计和训练方法，并指明了开放挑战与未来方向。

papers.title: Iris: Breaking GUI Complexity with Adaptive Focus and Self-Refining
papers.authors: Zhiqi Ge, Juncheng Li, Xinglei Pang, Minghe Gao, Kaihang Pan, Wang Lin, Hao Fei, Wenqiao Zhang, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University (作者1-6,8-10), National University of Singapore (作者7)
papers.intro: 本文提出Iris，一个通过信息敏感裁剪（ISC）自适应分配计算资源，并利用自精炼双学习（SRDL）以无额外标注方式迭代提升GUI指代与定位能力的视觉代理基础模型。

papers.title: Falcon-UI: Understanding GUI Before Following User Instructions
papers.authors: Huawen Shen, Chang Liu, Gengluo Li, Xinlong Wang, Yu Zhou, Can Ma, Xiangyang Ji
papers.affiliations: 1 Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences；2 VCIP & TMCC & DISSec, College of Computer Science, Nankai University；3 Department of Automation, Tsinghua University；4 Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence；5 School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出一种解耦指令与GUI上下文的训练范式，通过全自动生成的指令无关数据集Insight-UI对模型进行GUI理解预训练，再微调指令跟随，构建的Falcon-UI（7B参数）在多个基准上达到与72B Qwen2VL相当的性能，验证了GUI上下文理解的重要性。

papers.title: Aguvis: Unified Pure Vision Agents for Autonomous GUI Interaction
papers.authors: Yiheng Xu, Zekun Wang, Junli Wang, Dunjie Lu, Tianbao Xie, Amrita Saha, Doyen Sahoo, Tao Yu, Caiming Xiong
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University (Yiheng Xu, Zekun Wang, Junli Wang, Dunjie Lu, Tianbao Xie, Tao Yu); Salesforce Research (Amrita Saha, Doyen Sahoo, Caiming Xiong)
papers.intro: 提出了Aguvis，一个统一的纯视觉框架，通过直接操作屏幕图像、标准化跨平台交互和内在独白结构化推理，实现了离线与在线基准上的最先进性能，且无需闭源模型。

papers.title: VERA: Explainable Video Anomaly Detection via Verbalized Learning of Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Muchao Ye, Weiyang Liu, Pan He
papers.affiliations: The University of Iowa; Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen; Auburn University
papers.intro: VERA提出了一种基于言语化学习（Verbalized Learning）的框架，通过数据驱动地学习一组可解释的引导问题，使冻结的VLM无需指令微调或外部推理模块即可完成视频异常检测并提供解释。

papers.title: Large Language Model-Brained GUI Agents: A Survey
papers.authors: Chaoyun Zhang, Shilin He, Jiaxu Qian, Bowen Li, Liqun Li, Si Qin, Yu Kang, Minghua Ma, Guyue Liu, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang, Qi Zhang
papers.affiliations: Microsoft; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory; Peking University
papers.intro: 这篇综述全面梳理了以LLM为核心的GUI智能体领域，从演化历史到组件设计、框架、数据、模型、评估及实际应用，并提供了构建指南和未来路线图。

papers.title: ShowUI: One Vision-Language-Action Model for GUI Visual Agent
papers.authors: Kevin Qinghong Lin, Linjie Li, Difei Gao, Zhengyuan Yang, Shiwei Wu, Zechen Bai, Weixian Lei, Lijuan Wang, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.affiliations: Show Lab, National University of Singapore; Microsoft
papers.intro: ShowUI是一个基于Qwen2-VL-2B的轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型，通过UI引导的视觉令牌选择、交织的VLA流和高品质小规模指令数据集，在零样本截图定位上达到75.1%准确率，同时减少33%视觉令牌并加速训练1.4倍。

papers.title: AdaptAgent: Adapting Multimodal Web Agents with Few-Shot Learning from Human Demonstrations
papers.authors: Gaurav Verma, Rachneet Kaur, Nishan Srishankar, Zhen Zeng, Tucker Balch, Manuela Veloso
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology（Gaurav Verma）；J.P. Morgan AI Research（Rachneet Kaur, Nishan Srishankar, Zhen Zeng, Tucker Balch, Manuela Veloso）
papers.intro: 提出AdaptAgent框架，通过仅1-2次人类演示的上下文学习（专有模型）或元学习（开源模型），使多模态网页代理能够显著适应未见过的网站和领域，任务成功率绝对提升3.36%-7.21%，相对提升21.03%-65.75%。
